thread:
Aisha Patel: Quick heads-up — we're proposing a breaking change in the partner SDK (v4): remove the legacy `batch` field and require `X-Redwood-Auth: v2` header. This touches marketplace connectors, HW partner adapters, and a bunch of SI integrations.
Ben Chu: okay — can you confirm the concrete timeline?
Aisha Patel: API freeze in 3 weeks, then a 60-day deprecation window after the freeze. Want a coordinated partner announcement + marketplace listing updates.
Carlos Mendez: we should do a staged comms plan: private partner email, marketplace banner, release notes, and a public docs page + changelog blog. I can own the marketplace copy. :calendar:
Dana Li: I'll schedule partner calls. Can we put together a one-pager and a migration checklist I can share on the call? Also need an FAQ for SIs.
Luke Hwang: major note for HW partners: some on-prem gateways rely on the legacy `batch` semantics in our adapter SDK. 60 days is tight for firmware cycles; can we offer a compatibility shim or opt-in grace period for dedicated deployments?
Ben Chu: We can provide a compatibility shim in the SDK for 45 days post-freeze (feature-flagged) while partners migrate. Need to lock the exact header shape now so infra can add validation.
Emma Torres: SIs will need sample migrations and a failing-test harness. Offer to run a couple of integration runs with our SI test fleet if we get the shim and tests by EOD next Friday.
Aisha Patel: action items I hear: 1) Ben — publish header/field spec and compatibility shim plan (ETA 1 week). 2) Carlos — marketplace + docs timeline (ETA 10 days). 3) Dana — schedule partner calls + pack (ETA 5 days). 4) Luke/Emma — validate on-prem/hw/si impact and list blockers (ETA 7 days).
Ben Chu: publishing spec now. Minimal header change example below — will land in the SDK repo later this week:
```
# new requirement
X-Redwood-Auth: v2
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "requests": [...],
  "model": "redwood-l2"
}
# quick detect script
if curl -sI $ENDPOINT | grep -q "X-Redwood-Auth: v1"; then echo "legacy header in use"; fi
```
Carlos Mendez: good. I'll draft marketplace copy and a short migration guide section pointing to the SDK changelog.
Dana Li: partner call template (draft): agenda, technical impact, migration steps, timeline, support contacts, rollback options. Will share the doc link when ready.
Luke Hwang: appreciate the shim offer. If we can get a build with the shim in 7 days, we'll test against our gateway fleet and surface any firmware timing issues.
Emma Torres: can the SDK include a `--compat` flag that logs deprecated `batch` uses (so SIs can find failing codepaths)? That would help a lot.
Ben Chu: yes, plan is `--compat=warn|shim|strict`. Will include telemetry hooks so we can see adoption.
announce-bot: Scheduled reminder set for 2025-12-15 09:00 UTC to check rollback readiness.
Aisha Patel: perfect — I'll coordinate partner invites and draft the partner-facing email. Let's reconvene in 7 days with the runbook and the shim test results. :thumbsup:
